احتسيا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَيَا (iḥtasayā) /iħ.ta.sa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اُحْتُسِيَا (uḥtusiyā) /uħ.tu.si.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اِحْتَسِيَا (iḥtasiyā) /iħ.ta.si.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
